programs.name: Startmate Accelerator
programs.notes: Summer cohort ~Feb, Winter cohort ~Aug. Most important AU accelerator for our lens.

programs.name: Antler Australia
programs.notes: Multiple cohorts per year. AUS8-AUS12 naming convention. Check Startup Daily for cohort announcements.

programs.name: Iterative
programs.notes: YC-style for South and Southeast Asia. W and S batches. High signal for B2B SaaS.

programs.name: Accelerating Asia
programs.notes: C13 applications open Jan 2026. Cohort announces ~April. Impact-focused, strong fintech output.

programs.name: Seedcamp
programs.notes: Quarterly investments. Check blog for new portfolio announcements. Topograph was Seedcamp 2026.

programs.name: Skalata Ventures
programs.notes: Pre-Series A fund for $500K-$3M ARR AU/NZ B2B SaaS. Their investment note blog is the source. Double-validation when a company is also Antler/Startmate backed.

programs.name: Startup Wise Guys
programs.notes: Multiple cohorts/year across fintech, cybersecurity, SaaS, defence. Strong for non-obvious European geographies (Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania).

programs.name: Y Combinator (non-US filter)
programs.notes: W and S batches. W26: Demo Day March 24, 2026 — sweep pending (May 1). Filter: non-US founders, B2B SaaS, fintech, data infra. 196 companies in W26.

programs.name: FinTech Australia Finnies
programs.notes: Annual awards announced June. 2025 produced Fortiro (now on Radar). Focus categories: Emerging FinTech, Most Innovative Product, AI in Finance.

programs.name: MAS Singapore FinTech Festival Awards
programs.notes: Annual, announced November at SFF. 2025 produced Fennech (now on Radar). Hackcelerator + Excellence Awards. Focus: AI for financial services.

programs.name: Innovate UK Funded Projects
programs.notes: CSV database updated monthly. Smart Grants paused Jan 2025 — replaced by Growth Catalyst and Responsive programmes. Download CSV, filter by year/sector/size. 2025 sweep produced Scrub AI + Collaborative Conveyancing (now on Radar). Access via exec CSV download.

programs.name: Callaghan Innovation (NZ)
programs.notes: NZ's main R&D grant body. Grants are public. Filter for commercial software companies (not pure research). High signal when grant > NZ$100K.

programs.name: Antler Southeast Asia
programs.notes: Next SEA cohort May 11, 2026. Check Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam offices separately.

programs.name: AFR BOSS Most Innovative Companies
programs.notes: Paywalled — find via press releases from companies that announce their own win. Skews large corporate. Check October each year for startup-stage winners specifically. Low priority.

programs.name: WA Innovator of the Year
programs.notes: State-level but Perth is Larsen Ventures' home market. Worth checking annually.

programs.name: UK FinTech Awards
programs.notes: Industry body signal. Announced September. Check 'Best Startup' and 'Innovation' categories.

programs.name: NZ Hi-Tech Awards
programs.notes: Annual, announced May. Check 'Emerging Company' and 'Best New Product' categories.

programs.name: UK DASA (Defence and Security Accelerator)
programs.notes: Public grant recipients. Relevant for defence-adjacent or security/cyber companies. Filter for fintech/cybersecurity crossover plays.

programs.name: SparkLabs Seoul
programs.notes: Korea's leading early-stage accelerator. B2B SaaS, fintech, deeptech. Dense network into chaebols.

programs.name: Asia Tech X Singapore (ATxSG)
programs.notes: LOW SIGNAL — 2025 awards went to NEC Asia Pacific, Starhub, Seagate, Globant. Large corporates dominate. Skip unless specific startup category emerges.
